title: Down the Rabbit-Hole
language: English (project output language; content / camera_position / route_en / offset_en all English, landmark words copied verbatim from each layout.json name_en)
narration: off for the whole film (user setting output.narration_enabled=false). narration_anchors is intentionally absent; no group uses audio_plan narration_over; every dialogue-free group is ambient_only with its own silent_rationale.

entity_note: CRE-001 (Wild White Rabbit) is the real mute unclothed animal and appears ONLY in grp004 and grp006, registered in creatures[]. CHAR-white-rabbit (White Rabbit) is the waistcoated dream character and appears ONLY in grp011 / grp012 / grp028 / grp029, registered in characters[] with COS-006. The two are never the same entity.
costume_plan: CHAR-alice COS-001, CHAR-alice-sister COS-003, CHAR-white-rabbit COS-006. bible/costumes.json lists no change_point inside ep01 for any of the three, so no group boundary is forced by wardrobe and no adjacent group changes a costume. Wet from grp027 onward and the single white kid glove worn from sh084 onward are states / props (BIB-0029 ownership ruling), not costume changes.

shots.constraint: Static, deep staging, no move.
shots.content: A hot, still July afternoon. On the flat shelf of the bank under the elm, Alice's Sister sits upright reading a thick book; Alice lies on her stomach beside her, chin on her fists, idle. Beyond them the reed-edged backwater lies flat as glass; far across the meadow, a parish spire in the heat.
